hints.title: Consecutive Character Annihilation
hints.text: Adjacent characters that are consecutive in the circular alphabet cancel each other out.

hints.title: Cascading Reduction
hints.text: Removing a pair brings surrounding characters together, triggering potential further removals.

hints.title: Last-In Processing
hints.text: Inspect the most recent uncancelled character and pop whenever the current character is consecutive.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass reduction with circular distance check.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string splicing runs in O(n^2) worst-case time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the bracket matching equivalence and handle circular boundary wrap-around.
